name: Entity Reference Deck EB
description: Entity Browser host: FieldWidgetDisplay for stock EB (and optional multi-launcher) widgets, list/pill layout, and toolbar mount for erdeck_card view modes.
project_description: Host submodule of Entity Reference Deck for Entity Browser. Provides the 'entity_reference_deck' Entity Browser FieldWidgetDisplay plugin (EntityReferenceDeckDisplay), which renders each referenced entity through the shared EntityReferenceDeckCardBuilder and honours entity view access (falling back to a restricted label). A field_widget_complete_form_alter hook (FieldWidgetHooks) stamps deck CSS classes and listing modifiers on stock entity_browser_entity_reference (and optional entity_browser_multi) widgets that pick the deck display, and mounts preview field chrome when show_preview is set and the Preview submodule is enabled. Library 'widget'. Requires the contrib Entity Browser module.
